subject: r-batch files included in GRASS GIS:  error ""\R.exe"" false or not found

messages.author: d8df2fb358af885e
messages.subject: r-batch files included in GRASS GIS:  error ""\R.exe"" false or not found
parts:
Hi,

some time ago I've added the r batch files to GRASS GIS for a smooth R-winGRASS integration. [1]

invoking R within a GRASS GIS session worked fine (see screenshots in the mentioned wiki).

now I'm getting follow error (original in german, translated to englisch):

"Der Befehl ""\R.exe"" ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder konnte nicht gefunden werden."

"The command ""\R.exe"" is wrong or couldn't be found."

the r-batch files are living in:

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

This folder is included in %PATH%.

when I open a MS windows command line and switch manually to C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin, the r-batch files work quite nice (see also [2]):

C:\Users\xxxxx>cd C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin>R

> q()
Workspace sichern? [y/n/c]: n

C:\Program Files (x86)\GRASS GIS 7.1.svn\extrabin>

maybe a path issue? any idea?

thanks and kind regards
Helmut

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: r-batch files included in GRASS GIS:  error ""\R.exe"" false or not found
parts: The error message says its looking for R.exe in \  which is clearly the wrong place to look.    Remove the @echo off at the top of whatever batch file you are running and examine the output and that might lead you to the problem.  Its likely something specific to your system in which case you will need to do track it down yourself.
